mapper.sql: e.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, e.plant_cd, c.class_nm, s.sec_id, s.network_yn, s.os_nm, s.os_ver, s.os_eos_date, s.last_scan_date, s.scan_tool, s.target_sl, s.current_sl, s.usb_ctrl_yn, s.remote_access, s.remote_text, s.review_date, s.remark, s.row_ver, s.updated_at, s.updated_by
from mst_equip e join mst_equip_class c on c.class_id = e.class_id left join cms_equip_sec s on s.equip_id = e.equip_id
where (e.use_yn = 'Y' or s.sec_id is not null) and e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and (e.equip_cd like #{keyword} escape '\' or e.equip_nm ilike #{keyword} escape '\' or s.os_nm ilike #{keyword} escape '\')

order by
e.equip_cd desc e.equip_nm desc s.os_nm desc nulls last s.os_eos_date desc nulls last s.last_scan_date desc nulls last s.review_date desc nulls last e.plant_cd desc ,
e.equip_id
mapper.select: select sec_id from cms_equip_sec where equip_id = #{equipId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into cms_equip_sec (comp_cd, equip_id, network_yn, os_nm, os_ver, os_eos_date, last_scan_date, scan_tool, target_sl, current_sl, usb_ctrl_yn, remote_access, remote_text, review_date, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{equipId}, #{s.networkYn}, #{s.osNm}, #{s.osVer}, #{s.osEosDate}, #{s.lastScanDate}, #{s.scanTool}, #{s.targetSl}, #{s.currentSl}, #{s.usbCtrlYn}, #{s.remoteAccess}, #{s.remoteText}, #{s.reviewDate}, #{s.remark}, #{by}, #{by})
